rules.message: Looks like a secret key in the code — move it to an environment variable/secret
Looks like a Cloudflare token in the code — move it to an environment variable/secret

clientCode._note: identifiers = regex of table/column/secret-key names; code that can reach the browser and mentions them is blocked

privacy._note: Default patterns: Australian mobile numbers, landline numbers (02)…, LOT n DP n. Email is not blocked by default (the Co-Authored-By line of a commit contains an email). addressCheck: strong | all | off (apps with no client data, such as a game or a public handbook → off).

tidy._note: Used by /mission-tidy, by the after-edit hook (onEdit: warns about duplicate names / functions that already exist in another file / repeated blocks touching the file just edited, reminds you to record new files in .mission/LT.md; false = off) and by the check step «tidy --conflicts». include = real source code (not build output). sharedScope: each element is a group of files that run in a shared scope (a build that joins files, or several plain <script> tags) — a duplicate name within a group is a real conflict.

readGuard._note: Default: block reading secret files; ask before reading Desktop/Documents/Pictures/Videos/Music/OneDrive/Dropbox. extraPrivateDirs = add more private folders (ask); denyDirs = never read; privateDirs = replace the whole default list.

handoff._note: Only when the app sends work to ChatGPT for review (/mission-handoff). exchangeDir = outbox INSIDE the app, relative (e.g. docs/reviews/outbox); Claude pastes the text in it into ChatGPT using Claude's browser, not via Dropbox. Empty = off.

samples._note: Only for apps that read drawings (/mission-new-sample). Commands use {file} (file name in dir) and {name} (short name).
